values.goal: Coordinate the Distributed multi-agent Runtime qualification lane without absorbing child implementation ownership.
values.required_outcome: a complete terminal child ledger and independently reviewed lane synthesis is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: Dependency sequencing, status, serialization, evidence inventory, child handoffs, findings routing, and lane closeout for DRT-01, DRT-02, DRT-03, DRT-04, DRT-05, DRT-06, DRT-07.
authority_boundary: The umbrella may coordinate and synthesize but cannot modify child-owned product paths.
Children retain exclusive implementation and review ownership.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
